title: Liquid Glass theme for Shiny — glass_theme
code: theme <- glass_theme() dark <- glass_theme(preset = "dark", primary = "#BF5AF2") auto <- glass_theme(preset = "auto", tint = FALSE)  if (interactive()) {   library(shiny)    ui <- fluidPage(     theme = glass_theme(preset = "auto"),     titlePanel("Liquid Glass"),     actionButton("toggle", "Toggle light / dark"),     selectInput("color", "Color", c("Blue", "Purple", "Orange")),     plotOutput("plot")   )    server <- function(input, output, session) {     mode <- reactiveVal("light")     observeEvent(input$toggle, {       mode(if (identical(mode(), "light")) "dark" else "light")       update_glass_theme(session, preset = mode())     })   }    shinyApp(ui, server) }

title: shinyglass 0.2.0
text: Light dark glass surfaces now dual CSS custom-property packs [data-glass-preset]. Switching preset longer requires recompiling Sass reloading page. Apps overrode Sass-$glass-* tokens target --glass-* CSS variables ([data-glass-preset="dark"]) instead. glass_theme() always builds Bootstrap 5 base theme (Bootswatch darkly dark). Dark appearance comes CSS variable pack light↔︎dark can toggle live. Visuals match 0.1.x closely; relied darkly-specific chrome outside glass surfaces, re-check dark mode. Private escape hatch window.__shinyglassDisableTint still works, supported API glass_theme(tint = FALSE) / update_glass_theme(tint = …).

title: shinyglass 0.2.0
text: Runtime light/dark switching via document.documentElement.dataset.glassPreset without full reload. glass_theme(preset = "auto") follows prefers-color-scheme updates OS theme changes. [update_glass_theme()] change preset tint server. Behavior knobs [glass_theme()]: tint, specular, nav_morph (default TRUE, matching 0.1.x JS behavior). Client helper window.shinyglass.setPreset() / .getPreset() / .setTint().

title: shinyglass 0.1.1
text: CRAN release: 2026-08-02 Fix: bslib::sidebar() / page_sidebar() layout longer collapses full-width stack. Glass floating-sidebar rules now win bslib’s later position/width cascade, open sidebars reserve space main value boxes cards stay fully visible beside chrome (). Fix: nested layout_sidebar() longer double-floats. Inner sidebars keep glass styling use bslib’s -flow grid content pushed large empty gutter beside second absolute panel. Improve: AdminLTE chrome (classic shinydashboard bs4Dash) gets stronger glass overlay — translucent header/sidebar, soft-tinted value/info boxes, clearer menu active states — without breaking AdminLTE layout.

title: shinyglass 0.1.0
text: CRAN release: 2026-07-28 Initial release. glass_theme() returns bslib theme Liquid Glass styling shiny apps: translucent surfaces, backdrop blur, soft depth, system typography. Light dark presets, options accent color, blur, saturation, corner radius. Works fluidPage(), navbarPage(), bslib::page_sidebar(), page functions accept bslib theme. Pass theme via theme = glass_theme(), teal apps via options(teal.bs_theme = glass_theme()). Styles common Bootstrap Shiny surfaces (cards, navbars, sidebars, inputs, tables, plots, modals) holds denser UIs leaflet maps, DT, shinyWidgets, bs4Dash, teal filter panels.
